title: BlockActivation - RefCollectionAlias
content:
Member of: RefCollectionAlias Script Calls BlockActivation on all the references in the collection Syntax: Function BlockActivation(bool abBlocked = true, bool abHideActivateText = false) Parameters: - abBlocked: Whether to block activation or not Default: True - abHideActivateText: Whether to hide the activate text on the refs Default: False Return Value: None. Examples: ; Block activation on all the locked doors LockedDoorsCollection.BlockActivation()
; Block activation on all the puzzle parts, and hide their activate text LockedDoorsCollection.BlockActivation(abHideActivateText = true) See Also: - RefCollectionAlias Script - BlockActivation - ObjectReference
